title: At the end

nodes.text: Come close. It's alright -- I'm not afraid. I just wanted you near.
I know. You always were, when it counted.
That part isn't mine to choose. But this part -- being with you now -- is.
Thank you. For all of it. Remember me a little, will you?
That's all. That's everything.
...huh. The morning came anyway.
I think I'd like to stay a little longer, if that's alright.
Sit with me. I've been keeping count, you know. Every meal. Every game. Every time you came back.
I believe you. That's the strange thing about you -- I always believed you.
Then between us, nothing was lost. Not one day.
When I was small, I thought you were enormous. Then I grew, and you stayed exactly the right size.
Whatever comes next -- if anything does -- I'll be the part of it that remembers you.
Then neither of us is really going anywhere.
It doesn't hurt. It's just... quiet. Stay till I'm asleep?
...thank you. Good night.
...the quiet passed me by.
Well then. It seems you're not rid of me yet.
Come on. Let's see what a borrowed morning looks like.
You're sitting with me again. We've been here before, you and I.

choices.text: As many times as it takes

nodes.text: Every time, I think: one more day would be enough. And every time, it isn't.
This time feels different. Lighter.
It was enough. YOU were enough. Every single time.
...ha. Once more, then.
Don't look so surprised. I've had practice.
